outcome: Blood metabolites (glutamate, serine, asparagine, aspartic acid, homocysteine, phenylalanine)
Metabolic pathways (aminoacyl-tRNA biosynthesis, alanine, aspartate, and glutamate metabolism)
cohort: The study included 32 neonates with idiopathic polyhydramnios and 32 normal control neonates admitted to the Sixth Affiliated Hospital of Sun Yat-sen University.
finding: There was a significant difference in blood metabolism between newborns with IPH and those with normal amniotic fluid, with six discriminant metabolites identified that may affect amino acid synthesis and nervous system development.
